item.description:
The DigiLocker SDK provides a streamlined flow for integrating DigiLocker authentication and document retrieval into your application.  
  

Experience the SDK: [https://demo.sandbox.co.in/kyc/digilocker](https://demo.sandbox.co.in/kyc/digilocker)

  
  
Below is the API flow:

**1\. Create Session (POST):** Initiates a new SDK session to launch DigiLocker, allowing users to begin authentication and consent flows. Through the session, users log in to DigiLocker and grant necessary consent for the host application.

**2\. Session Status (GET):** The host app can check the current status of the user within the SDK session, monitoring progress, consent, and completion.

**3\. Get Document (GET):** Once the user completes the session and gives consent, the host app can retrieve documents securely via the Get Document API.

This SDK centralizes user authentication, consent management, and secure document access, offering a simple integration to leverage DigiLocker’s features within your application.

body.raw:
{
    "@entity": "in.co.sandbox.kyc.digilocker.session.request",
    "flow": "signin",
    "redirect_url": "https://developer.sandbox.co.in/",
    "doc_types": [
        "aadhaar"
    ],
    "options": { // Options object to customer user experience
        "verification_method": [ // Sign up flow only. Allow user to verify using specific methods during sign up. Possible values: aadhaar, pan, driving_license, email, username, mobile, other
            "aadhaar"
        ],
        "pinless": true, // Sign in flow only. Allow user to skip PIN and Login directly with OTP. Possible values: true, false
        "usernameless": true, // Sign up flow only. Allow user to skip username setup while DigiLocker sign up. Possible values: true, false
        "verified_mobile": "9999999999" // Sign up flow only. Allow user to skip mobile OTP verification during sign up if you have verified it already by passing it in the request.
    },
    "consent_expiry": 1751975600361 // Consent expiry in epoch (10 digit), must be at least 1 hour later than the current time. Default is 1 hour from now.
}
